purpose: True platinum-free interval (PFI; resistant if PFI < 182 days) + germline/somatic HRR mutation -> PFS/OS validation

resolvable_controlled_study.name: The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) - includes Ovarian Serous Cystadenocarcinoma (OV)
resolvable_controlled_study.verified: study.cgi resolves HTTP 200; page contains 'Ovarian','TCGA','Cancer Genome Atlas'

gog0218_dbgap_status.finding: GOG-0218 has NO dedicated resolvable dbGaP phs accession. The only esearch hits for 'GOG-0218' resolve to phs000280 (ARIC / atherosclerosis) via incidental document text-match, not the ovarian trial.
gog0218_dbgap_status.implication: GOG-0218 patient-level clinical + HRR data is NOT in dbGaP. HRR outcomes are published (Norquist BM et al., Clin Cancer Res 2018;24(4):777-783, DOI 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-17-1327). Raw GOG/NRG data requires a separate NRG Oncology / Project Data Sphere request (see W1), not a dbGaP DAR.

true_pfi_variable_map.definition: PFI = time from last platinum dose (or completion of platinum) to first documented progression/recurrence. Platinum-RESISTANT if PFI < 182 days (6 months); sensitive if >= 182 days.

tcga_ov_source_variables.concept: platinum therapy end date / therapy record

tcga_ov_source_variables.source: Liu et al. Cell 2018 TCGA-CDR (Clinical Data Resource) provides curated PFI + PFI.time as an alternative to raw derivation
tcga_ov_source_variables.note: TCGA-CDR is the recommended endpoint source

true_pfi_variable_map.resistant_flag_rule: resistant = (PFI.time < 182 AND PFI event==1) i.e. progression within 6 months of platinum

hrr_variable_map.germline_source: TCGA germline calls (controlled) — e.g. Huang et al. Cell 2018 pathogenic germline variants; requires DAR
hrr_variable_map.somatic_source: TCGA MC3 somatic MAF (controlled-tier for full; PanCanAtlas)
hrr_variable_map.readout: HRR-mutant (germline OR somatic pathogenic in core genes) vs wild-type -> Kaplan-Meier PFS/OS; expected: HRR-mut prolongs PFS/OS (concordant with Norquist 2018 in GOG-0218)
hrr_variable_map.claim_it_cures: true platinum-resistance labeling + HRR prognostic wiring

dar_payload.consent_groups: TCGA General Research Use (GRU) + Health/Medical/Biomedical as applicable
requires: signed Data Use Certification by an institutional Signing Official
dar_payload.note: This is a signed institutional web action; it CANNOT be filed programmatically from this environment. Script below is parameterized to run only AFTER approval, using the user's own .ngc key.

ngc_gated_pull_script: prefetch --ngc <USER_PROJECT.ngc> <phs000178 dbGaP sample accessions>; then dbGaP-to-vcf/maf extraction. Runs only post-DAR-approval.
live_auth_state: NOT_ATTEMPTED (dbGaP controlled data requires signed DAR + user's .ngc key; no credential login possible from here)
